interface.description: Network interface to monitor (required); e.g., eth0

dag.description: Use native DAG API if capstats was built with DAG support

bpf_filter.description: Berkeley Packet Filter (BPF) expression to filter captured traffic

use_syslog.description: Log to syslog instead of printing to stderr

stop_after.description: Stop after outputting this many intervals

payload_byte.description: Verify that packet payloads consist entirely of this byte value (0–255)

quiet_threshold.description: Suppress output; exit with success (0) if at least this many packets received

expected_size.description: Verify that packets match this exact size in bytes

snaplen.description: Set pcap snapshot length (bytes); default depends on libpcap

write_file.description: Write captured packets to this file in pcap format
